title: A non-pth-power in a finite type characteristic-p domain is detected by a derivation
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number and $B$ an integral domain with $p=0$ in $B$, with fraction field $M$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Assume that there are a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring $(R_0,\mathfrak m_0)$ which is $\mathfrak m_0$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] and a ring map $R_0\to B$ of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Let $f\in B$ be an element which is not a $p$th power in $M$. Then there is a derivation $D:B\to B$ (an additive map with $D(ab)=aD(b)+bD(a)$) with $D(f)\neq0$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07PH (lemma-find-D), line 11703 and proof
